summary:
Implemented three iPhone-visible slices:

Anton Console now has manual-copy fallback text for Review Pack and Sign-Off copy/share failures, plus a `Use In Sign-Off` action. Hood and Cabin now get direct iPhone bottom actions for Finder, Fuses, Check, and Saved. Maintenance bottom actions now deep-link through persistent service contexts, including Run Pack. Bumped PWA cache to `ridgeline-console-v449`.

Verification passed: `node --check anton-console.js`, `node --check shared-ui.js`, `node --check service-worker.js`, `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`, and `git diff --check` with only LF-to-CRLF warnings. `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('anton.html')` timed out again, matching the known wrapper issue.

Next slice: repair or replace the browser smoke path, then visually verify Anton, Hood/Cabin fuse rails, and Maintenance action persistence on an iPhone-sized viewport.
